_comment: DIGITAL_GOOD product (非授权 / 先付后用) — an e-book / template pack / media zip. publish.mjs uploads assets.sourceCodeFile as businessType product_file -> baseInfo.sourceCodeFile. Rules (see reference.md): softwareVersion x.y.z required; digitalGoodsTypeId required (from GET /frontApi/digitalGoodsType/all); receivePayment.productPrice >= 1; NO deploy fields (deployPrice/deployIncome) and no serverSoftwareDeployRole/afterSalesFreeDay.

baseInfo.summary: A downloadable digital product: a zipped pack of conversion-focused landing page templates.

introduce.functions: 10 responsive landing pages, dark/light themes, Figma + HTML source.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Indie hackers and small teams shipping marketing pages fast.
introduce.usageScenarios: Launch a product landing page in an afternoon by editing a template.
introduce.painPoints: Building polished landing pages from scratch is slow and error-prone.
